speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you have an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node, which can sometimes indicate issues with organs in the abdomen or chest. Can you describe the location and character of your abdominal pain, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any painless swelling in your neck or armpits, and have you experienced any fevers or itchy skin? I will also order a CT scan of your chest, abdomen, and pelvis to look for internal lymph node enlargement or masses.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: CT_Chest_Abdomen_Pelvis
Do you experience any itching, especially at night, and have you had any unexplained fevers?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes.

speaker: Doctor
text: The CT confirms widespread lymphadenopathy, which is highly concerning for lymphoma. Do you have a history of alcohol consumption that causes pain in these swollen nodes, and have you experienced severe itching, particularly at night?

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: The abdominal fullness suggests splenomegaly, which fits with the widespread lymphadenopathy. To confirm the diagnosis and determine the specific subtype, I need a tissue sample. REQUEST TEST: Lymph_Node_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20.

speaker: Doctor
text: The CD20 positivity and high proliferative index confirm a diagnosis of aggressive B-cell lymphoma, most likely Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma. DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
